proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL chattvara gives Lahnda/Punjabi chappar thatched roof, West Pahari chappar straw hut/thatched roof, and specifically Jaunsari chāpar in the addendum. The survey chappar/chapor responses match this family; affricate notation, gemination and vowels are preserved. Regional IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: tʃʌpːʌɾa.
